notes.title: Let’s March Forward! Celebrating Toge Productions 15th Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/917f34a32ef0ad669e466d6e19bf2b3b7ae829a8.png[/img]

[h3][i]Salute, Pilots![/i][/h3]
[h3]Happy 15th Anniversary to Toge Productions! We are dropping in with an exclusive trailer showcasing the updates for what’s to come. [/h3]

Thank you for your patience, Pilots. It’s been a while since our last update to the latest demo build. We have been working behind the scenes to bring you the best experience possible in the next update we are currently working on. But first, here’s a sneak peek at the progress update trailer showcasing some of the updates you might like to see. 

[b]Check our progress trailer here! [/b]
[previewyoutube=L0kB4ad32Ig;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are a few key takes on what we have been working so far: 
- The explorable map function. Where you, as the pilot, can move around the area of Nusanesia. Take control of the war by strategizing and choosing your battle carefully. The narrative is also undergoing continuous development, expanding the lore much further. 
- Kriegers (mechs) and environment interaction. We are currently working on a feature where Kriegers will be able to destroy jungles and walls, creating a more creative opportunity for the pilots to take advantage of the battlefield. 
- Improvement towards the turn-based cinematics. When entering the battle phase, different and improved camera placement will be shown to make you more immersed in the battle. 

Please keep us updated with us as we are preparing one of our most comprehensive updates. Keep your eyes peeled, as it will come sooner than you might expected. Follow us on social media or join our community to know the latest news. 

[h2]Follow us on socials or join our community! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/431828c62ac7efd30e5a74c3af13c5e7c66363f1.png[/img][url=https://twitter.com/kriegsfront][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/524a4d99ff054fe65be300e78c53ad4095a6d331.png[/img][/url][url=discord.gg/toge][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/1611ad59194304f837f130f6a146f2d2a2a61b44.png[/img][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/3d35de8093e02dbd0521ee9a3e1f7b93dcce8507.png[/img]

Also, let’s have a great year forward. 
Stay safe and godspeed, Pilots. 

The Kriegsfront Team.

notes.title: Kriegsfront Tactics Demo Update - Destructible Environments
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/95a15a5770376271324535558a038554d8b37ff1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Salute, Pilots[/h1]

August is a special month in Southeast Asia as Singapore, Indonesia, and Malaysia celebrate their National/Independence Day this month.

To celebrate the occasion, we’ve updated our demo with new features.
[previewyoutube=8EyLvj-dKAA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Destructible Environment[/h2]
Your attacks will affect the environment as now trees and buildings be destroyed. Are enemies hiding in the jungle or behind buildings? You can bombard the jungle and remove their cover.

[h2]Pilot Skill Activations[/h2]
Pilots will have latent skills that can activate during battle. This is still a work in progress but you can see some of it implemented, such as Shield Up and Evasion skills.

Also, we will be attending Gamescom in Cologne, Germany, next week. [b]Visit us at Indie Arena Booth on Koelnmesse, Hall 10.2, booth F010g - E019g[/b]. Some of our Toge crews will be there, so please come by and say hi.

[h3][b]Follow and Wishlist Kriegsfront Tactics on Steam[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561740/Kriegsfront_Tactics/

Stay safe, and godspeed, Pilots.

notes.title: Kriegsfront Tactics Devlog Series - Episode #3 Reviving Mecha Tactics RPG
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/e3c726f3d94a66ea2e543c021ede299694eec0dc.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Salute, Pilots![/h3][/i]
Delves deeper into the history of Kriegsfront Tactics with the third episode in the Kriegsfront devlog series. [b] Whether you're just joining in or have been supporting us from the start of the development, let's take a look at how it all started.[/b] 

This Devlog is a behind-the-scenes series about the game development process of Kriegsfront Tactics. In this episode, we showed our development journey reviving the mecha TRPG genre, from when we started to our current progress. We describe briefly how all of the processes of how Kriegsfront Tactics become from its initial prototype, design update, diorama editor, and the recent combat demo. We are committed to bringing you the best of turn-based, mecha tactics RPG as how we envisioned it 5 years ago. We hope you enjoy our series and stay tuned for more updates that will come this year. 

In this third episode, Kris Antoni, the Game Director of Kriegsfront Tactics, will briefly unfold the history behind Kriegsfront Tactics until its current development. As an Indonesian game developer studio, we put much of our vision of how we see mecha tactics games from our perspective and how we explore the gameplay we want by combining designs and foundations we are deeply passionate about. The backing from our community around the world that had been garnered from the different types of games we released also enabled us to explore new genres that we never made before, leading us to the creation and continuous development of Kriegsfront Tactics. 

[h3]Watch the first episode here to find out more![/h3]
[previewyoutube=HUpRvFbWlJc;full][/previewyoutube]

In this yet short, yet packed information about the history of Kriegsfront Tactics, Kris also will share the newest progression of our development with procedural world exploration. Look forward to how we implemented this feature later this year. These are six topics to be covered in the third episode: 

1. How it started VS how it's going
2. Reactions to our Combat Demo
3. Enemy AI Improvements
4. Procedural world exploration
5. Environmental destruction
6. Skill activation and cinematic camera

[h2]Are you interested in more devlog content? [/h2]
[h3]You can watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLRWdKAPoZlJy6oXAYwqw7RAlNrMEDtS1_]the full playlist[/url] here.[/h3]

[b]If you're curious to see more about Kriegsfront Tactics, be sure to follow us! [/b]
[i]Kriegsfront Tactics Devlog is planned to be updated monthly, so be sure to check the playlist when a new video drops in. [/i] Do you have anything in mind about other relevant topics you might be interested in? Please feel free to comment down below or join our discord community to directly get in touch with us. 

[h3]Wishlist and Follow Kriegsfront Tactics for more! [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561740/Kriegsfront_Tactics

[h3]Join the Toge Productions Discord server here![/h3]
Feel the urge to discuss about Kriegsfront Tactics with other enthusiastic fans in the genre? 
Come and join our discord community! [url=discord.gg/toge]Toge Productions Discord [/url]

See you soon, and godspeed, Pilots.

notes.title: Kriegsfront Tactics Appearing at TactiCon 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/ed621122650ab5baa1b8a82e762504d2af912a72.png[/img]

Salute, Pilots! 

Kriegsfront Tactics is making an appearance in TactiCon 2023, a digital event on Steam for strategy video games organized by Hooded House and Firesquid. TactiCon 2023 is commencing on Steam from 11th May until 15th May, where you can try out a selection of the best strategy games showcased each year. With a wide variety of genres such as deckbuilding, base building, tactical RPG, grand strategy, and turn-based tactics, there’s a game that will catch your attention. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/54cd01ef17cd1203df42731e60d7d850d691be7a.jpg[/img][i]Krigsfront Tactics features low-poly 3D graphics that will grab the attention of old and new fans of the genre. [/i]

Kriegsfront Tactics is a turn-based tactical mecha RPG in the alternate 1970s, during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia. Take a role as the commander of an estranged squad to survive another day in the signature jungle environment that surrounds Southeast Asia. This time in TactiCon we want to showcase the non-linear, dynamic gameplay of how the game will come to be in the final build. Updating from the previous demo, we hope to show more gameplay to excite our fans. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/a1bd34046a5196ee47c653101f7115640e935817.jpg[/img][i]Take control of a squad of pilots with different Krieger loadouts offering different playstyles. [/i]

We are bringing out the updated demo of Kriegsfront Tactics with a new map-level design to try out. Bringing another layer of tactical warfare to the battlefield with a new pilot character with his mecha and weapon. It will be a whole new experience compared to our latest demo showcase, where we want to showcase the high replayability value of our level design. We highly recommend our fans to play the demo, and we look forward to your response. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/2b45cc6022b28184bf873c5a43fb55012526a7ac.jpg[/img][i]A new, updated demo with higher replayability value that's getting closer to our final projection for Kriegsfront Tactics. 
[/i]
A series of devlog videos for Kriegsfront are also in the works and available to watch on Youtube. Get a closer look at our development steps, insights, and what’s more to come for Kriegsfront Tactics. The devlog is now available up to the second episode to watch, and more will be coming in the future.

You can check out the playlist for our currently available devlog here:
[previewyoutube=brzBmPcc3_k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Wishlist Kriegsfront Tactics on Steam![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561740/Kriegsfront_Tactics/

[b]Keep updated with us through our social media channels, as we are bringing more teasers this year.[/b] Come and join our community and share your experience trying out the latest demo update. We would love to know your response and try to improve the gameplay much more to bring a more authentic experience for our fans. 

Stay safe and godspeed, Pilots. 


The Kriegsfront Team.
